data.name: Chains of Eternity
data.detailed_description:
It's 2034. Tokyo.
The heavens have suddenly fallen down upon our realm, and the angels brought an apocalypse. 
You died trying to save others.
Suddenly, you wake up in a school's classroom, and the calendar is showing 2017. 
What on earth could have happened?



Enter a unforgiving world bound by ancient fate and dark design. Chains of Eternity is a story-driven Action RPG built in RPG Maker MZ, combining intense real-time combat, stylish anti-hero storytelling, and a haunting world where every choice carries weight.



You play as Nolan, relentless protagonist with many regrets bound to a tragic fate, cutting through hordes of monstrous foes and unraveling a complex, philosophical narrative. Designed with fluid motion, dynamic visual flair, and deep customization at its core, Chains of Eternity offers a fast-paced twist on the traditional top-down RPG experience.



Multiple levels: From Hell itself all the way to Heaven.
Day, afternoon, and night cycles: Go to school during the day, slay bad guys during the night in the Red Light District
Side quests: Help decide the fate of your past friends.
Meaningful npc encounters: Everyone has their own life to worry about in Tokyo.
Multiple endings: You need to consider your choices.

Are you up for the challenge?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4340 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL compatible GPU with 1 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: 1280x720 or higher display resolution
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated or integrated GPU with OpenGL support and 2 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: 1920x1080 display recommended

content_descriptors.notes:
The game contains violence and violence acts against the enemies you defeat in the game.

Furhtermore, the game contains a small amount of skippable 18+ cutscenes.
